session.text: Hey Tim, nice to meet you! What's up? Anything new happening?

session.speaker: John
session.blip_caption: a photo of a bench in a locker with several lockers behind it
session.text: Things are going well! The team has been really nice and I'm having fun. How's your fan project coming along?

session.speaker: Tim
session.blip_caption: a photo of a table with a bunch of books on it
session.query: harry potter books fan project collaboration wizarding world
session.text: It's been going well! Last week I talked to my friend who is a fan of Harry Potter and we're figuring out ideas, so it's been great to get lost in that magical world!

session.speaker: John
session.blip_caption: a photo of a circle of shoes on the floor in a room
session.text: That's great! Loving it when people are passionate about their work. What kind of collaborations are you involved in for the fan project? I love talking to people about my sneaker collection.

session.speaker: Tim
session.text: Thanks! We'll be discussing various aspects of the Harry Potter universe, like characters, spells, and magical creatures. It's great to see fans coming together for this.

session.speaker: John
session.blip_caption: a photo of a bookcase filled with books and toys
session.text: Wow! Have you been to any places related to it?

session.speaker: Tim
session.text: I went to a place in London a few years ago - it was like walking into a Harry Potter movie! I also went on a tour which was amazing. Have you been to any of the real Potter places? I'd love to explore them someday!

session.speaker: John
session.text: No, but it sounds fun! Going to those places is definitely on my to-do list.

session.speaker: Tim
session.text: Definitely add it to your list! It's a really fun experience. Let me know if you need any tips for visiting. Bye!
